PRODUCT DATA SHEET: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: PRODUCT DATA SHEET, edition not printed (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/sikasil_sg-500_cn.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide PRODUCT DATA SHEET where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (edition not printed).
1.2 Product description. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (edition not printed).
1.3 Intended uses. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (edition not printed).

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. PRODUCT DATA SHEET
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (edition not printed) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - CQP001-1: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where:  > Properties (p.1).
    - ISO 527: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where:  > Viscosity (CQP029-6) (p.1).
    - CQP554-1: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where:  > Viscosity (CQP029-6) (p.1).
    - CQP019-3: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where:  > Viscosity (CQP029-6) (p.1).
    - CQP023-1: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where:  > Viscosity (CQP029-6) (p.1).
    - CQP036-1: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where:  > Viscosity (CQP029-6) (p.1).
    - CQP045-1: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where:  > Viscosity (CQP029-6) (p.1).
    - CQP513-1: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where:  > Viscosity (CQP029-6) (p.1).
    - ASTM C 1184: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where:  > Viscosity (CQP029-6) (p.1).
    - ASTM C 920: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where:  > Viscosity (CQP029-6) (p.1).

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (edition not printed) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (edition not printed) and the requirements below.
4.2 . 2-component silicone structural glazing adhesive, complying astm and GB standards TYPICAL PRODUCT DATA (FURTHER VALUES SEE SAFETY DATA SHEET)

    - Very good UV and weathering resistance
    - Long term durability
    - Quality product based on proven and constant quality raw materials AREAS OF APPLICATION Sikasil® SG-500 CN is ideal for structural glazing and similar high-demanding industrial applications. This product is suitable for experienced professional users only. Tests with actual substrates and conditions have to be performed ensuring adhesion and material compatibility.
    - Safety Data Sheets
    - General Guideline Structural Silicone Glazing with Sikasil® SG Adhesives PACKAGING INFORMATION Sikasil® SG-500 CN (A)
    | 1 200 Pa·s | 300 Pa·s |
    | ambient | 5 ─ 40 °C |
    | CQP = Corporate Quality Procedure | A) 23 °C / 50 % r. h. | 15 months B | 12 months B |
    | DESCRIPTION | PRODUCT BENEFITS |
    | Sikasil® SG-500 CN is a 2-component, high-modulus, neutral-curing structural silicone adhesive. This product is designed to be used in structural glazing applications. | Meets requirements of ASTM C 1184, ASTM C 920 (class 25, movement capability ± 25 %) and GB 16776 Design tensile strength for dynamic loads: σdes = 0.14 MPa or 20 psi (ASTM) |
    | CURE MECHANISM | Removal |
    | Sikasil® SG-500 CN starts to cure immediately after mixing the two components. | Uncured Sikasil® SG-500 CN may be removed from tools and equipment with Sika® Re- |
    | The speed of the reaction depends mainly on the temperature, i.e. the higher the temperature the faster the curing process. Heating above 50 °C could lead to bubble formation and is therefore not allowed. | mover-208 or an-other suitable solvent. Once cured, the material can only be removed mechanically. Re-usable, usually metallic, static mixer can be cleaned with Sika® Mixer Cleaner. |
    | The mixer open time, i. e. the time the material can remain in the mixer without flushing or extrusion of product, is significantly shorter than the snap time indicated above. METHOD OF APPLICATION | Hands and exposed skin have to be washed immediately using hand wipes such as Sika® Cleaner-350H cleaning towels or a suitable industrial hand cleaner and water. Do not use solvents on skin. |
    | Surface preparation | Overpainting |
    | Surfaces must be clean, dry and free from grease, oil and dust. Surface treatment depends on the specific nature of the substrates and is crucial for a long lasting bond. | Sikasil® SG-500 CN cannot be overpainted. |
    | Application |
    | The optimum temperature for substrate and sealant is between 15 °C and 25 °C. |
    | Before processing Sikasil® SG-500 CN both components have to be mixed homogeneously and air-bubble-free in the correct ratio as indicated with an accuracy of ±10 %. Most commercially available metering and mixing equipment are suitable. For advice on selecting and setting up a suitable pump system, contact the System Engineering Department of Sika Industry. |
    | Consider that the B-component is moisture-sensitive and must therefore only be exposed briefly to air. |
    | Joints must be properly dimensioned. |
    | Basis for calculation of the necessary joint dimensions are the technical values of the adhesive and the adjacent building materials, the exposure of the building elements, their construction and size as well as external loads. |
    | Tooling and finishing |
    | Tooling and finishing must be carried out within the snap time of the adhesive. |
    | When tooling freshly applied Sikasil® SG-500 |
    | CN, press the adhesive to the joint flanks to get a good wetting of the bonding surface. No tooling agents must be used. |
    | Sikasil® SG-500 CN (B) | Drum | 260 kg |
    | Pail | 20 kg |

    Application limits Recommended solution from Sika for structural glazing and window bonding are usually compatible to each other. These solutions consist of products such as Sikasil® SG, IG, WS and WT series. For specific information regarding compatibility between various Sikasil® products and other Sika products contact the Technical Department of Sika Industry. To exclude materials influencing Sikasil® SG- 500 CN, all materials such as gaskets, setting blocks, sealants etc., in direct and indirect contact have to be approved by Sika in advance. Where two or more different reactive sealants are used, allow the first to cure completely before applying the next one. The above mentioned Sika process materials may only be used in structural glazing or window bonding applications after a detailed examination and written approval of the corresponding project details by Sika Industry. FURTHER INFORMATION The information herein is offered for general guidance only. Advice on specific applications is available on request from the Technical Department of Sika Industry. Copies of the following publications are available on request:
    BASIS OF PRODUCT DATA All technical data stated in this document are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control. DISCLAIMER The information, and, in particular, the recommendations relating to the application and enduse of Sika products, are given in good faith based on Sika's current knowledge and experience of the products when properly stored, handled and applied under normal conditions in accordance with Sika's recommendations. In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered. The user of the product must test the product's suitability for the intended application and purpose. Sika reserves the right to change the properties of its products. The proprietary rights of third parties must be observed. All orders are accepted subject to our current terms of sale and delivery. Users must always refer to the most recent issue of the local Product Data Sheet for the product concerned, copies of which will be supplied on request.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (edition not printed) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: PRODUCT DATA SHEET, edition not printed, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/sikasil_sg-500_cn.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: sikasil SG-500 CN Comp. B, version 22/12/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/Sikasil%20SG-500%20CN%20Part%20B.pdf%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikasil® SG-500 CN Part A, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sds-sikasil-sg-500cnparta.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikasil® SG-500 CN Part B, version 14/05/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sds-sikasil-sg-500cnpartb.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (edition not printed).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
